name: MEGA Table Sync
description: Installs table bundles from a MEGA folder when VPinFE starts.
settings.label: MEGA Table Sync
settings.mega_exe.label: MEGAcmd Client
settings.mega_exe.help: The MEGAclient program from MEGAcmd. Log in to MEGAcmd outside VPinFE first. Use Sync Now in the MEGA Sync list to see whether it is connected.
settings.mega_folder.label: MEGA Folder
settings.mega_folder.help: The MEGA folder holding table zips. Installed zips move to an imported folder inside it, and zips for tables you already have move to rejected.
settings.sync_on_start.label: Sync When VPinFE Starts
settings.sync_on_start.help: Install new table zips shortly after VPinFE starts. There is no periodic sync.
settings.vpinfe_port.label: VPinFE Port
settings.vpinfe_port.help: The web server port from Settings > VPinFE > Network. After an import, the extension asks VPinFE on this device to refresh the library so new tables register.
error.not_megacmd: This is not the MEGAcmd client. Choose MEGAclient.exe from the MEGAcmd folder.
error.download_missing: The download did not produce a zip.
error.size_mismatch: The downloaded file is not the size MEGA lists.
action.sync.label: Sync Now
action.sync.description: Install new table zips from MEGA
action.sync.help: Installs table zips found in the MEGA folder. Tables already in your library are moved to rejected without downloading.
status.cannot_sync: MEGAcmd is not installed or not logged in.
status.line.not_installed: MEGAcmd is not installed at the chosen path.
list.tables.title: MEGA Sync
list.tables.column.date.help: When this extension imported or rejected the zip. Before that, the date MEGA lists for it.
list.tables.column.state.help: Where the zip is in MEGA.
list.tables.column.state.state.waiting.w: Still in the MEGA folder, to install at the next sync.
Installed and moved to the imported folder.
The table is already in your library.
list.tables.column.matched.help: Whether VPinFE matched an imported table to the VPS catalog.
list.tables.column.game.help: The game in your library, once the table is installed. Select it to open the game.
list.tables.column.error.help: Why the zip last failed. It is tried again at the next start, and the error clears once it imports.
need.not_installed.label: MEGAcmd is not installed
need.not_installed.says: MEGA Table Sync cannot find MEGAcmd at the chosen path.
need.not_connected.label: MEGAcmd is not logged in
need.not_connected.says: Log in to MEGAcmd so new tables can be installed.
